title: Duplicate federation delivery receipt at the home hard-codes notificationDisposition durableButNotWoken instead of the original's at-send outcome
outcome: A duplicate federation delivery at the mailbox home returns the original message's stored dispatch outcome as notificationDisposition, so the send result's AT SEND TIME line names the original's wake outcome.
acceptance: Duplicate federation delivery receipt at the home hard-codes notificationDisposition durableButNotWoken instead of the original's at-send outcome is done
